## Problem

What can't you do today? Which glyph is missing or behaves wrong?

## Proposed solution

What should the typeface do? Reference images, sketches, or comparison glyphs from other typefaces are ideal.

## Alternatives considered

Other typefaces or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional context

Links to type design references, similar typefaces, or related issues.
